description: Defines the AcceleratedVideoDecoder interface for hardware-accelerated video decoding, including methods for setting stream data, flushing, resetting, decoding, and retrieving video properties.

classes.name: media::AcceleratedVideoDecoder
classes.description: Interface for hardware-accelerated video decoders supporting stream setting, flushing, resetting, and property retrieval.

methods.name: SetStream
methods.description: Sets the current stream buffer for decoding, identified by an integer ID.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the decoder state and outputs all decoded surfaces.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Pauses decoding and discards remaining inputs and outputs without flushing.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Attempts to decode more stream data asynchronously, returning a result status.

methods.name: GetPicSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the current picture/frame.

methods.name: GetVisibleRect
methods.description: Returns the visible rectangle of the current frame.

methods.name: GetBitDepth
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the video stream.

methods.name: GetHDRMetadata
methods.description: Returns in-band HDR metadata if available.

methods.name: GetRequiredNumOfPictures
methods.description: Returns the number of pictures needed for decoding.

methods.name: GetNumReferenceFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of reference frames.
